SELECT s.name, MAX(CAST((julianday(m.resolved_on) - julianday(m.reported_on)) AS INTEGER)) as longest_days
FROM station s
JOIN bike b ON s.station_id = b.station_id
JOIN maintenance m ON b.bike_id = m.bike_id
WHERE m.resolved_on IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY s.station_id, s.name
HAVING COUNT(m.maint_id) > 0;
